videos.title: What Happens When a Car Hits a Tree at 30 MPH? 🌳🚗
videos.description:
In slow motion: the crumple zone folds, the airbag fills in ~30 ms, and the seatbelt holds the dummy. The whole crash takes about 0.1 seconds.
Old steel tank or modern crumple zone? Which would you rather be in? 👇
